text: GTA 6 is out, and GTA clips are taking over every feed. And clippers are getting paid for views.
MrBeast and IShowSpeed campaigns pay around a dollar for every thousand views.
The hard part is finding the moment. A three-hour stream. One crazy chase.
This tool finds it for you. It's called Klap.
You paste the stream link. It picks the best moments, and scores each one for how viral it could go.
It cuts them vertical, keeps the gameplay and the streamer in frame, and adds captions that pop.
So while other clippers are still scrubbing hour two, your clip is already up.
Comment Klap, and I'll send you the link. Or grab it from my bio.
